error_name_cause: The execute function embedded the literal TARGETED_FOUR_SOL_CALL_LIMIT independently of the active dataset or experiment identity.
finding: Evaluation stage identity, model-call quotas, monetary limits, and error vocabulary were represented by mutable module globals. The V2 wrapper changed TARGETS, OUT, EXPERIMENT_ID, and BUDGET_CAP_USD but inherited MAX_SOL_CALLS=5 and the targeted-four error strings.
injection_path: Module import established MAX_SOL_CALLS=5 for TARGETED_FOUR
The V2 wrapper selected 60 TARGETS and a $0.30 budget
No explicit stage-guard object was created
execute() retained the targeted MAX_SOL_CALLS value and error name
luna_counter_before_fix: No explicit local Luna counter; counts were derived after execution from the stage output ledger.
persistence: The local sol_calls variable reset on each execute() invocation, while the monetary ledger persisted under OUT. Neither had an explicit stage identity contract.
